result.rationale: The new file packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts explicitly contains `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` when the response lacks refresh_token, and callers (e.g. GoogleCalendarService, zoomVideoAdapter via parseRefreshTokenResponse, SalesforceCalendarService) persist the parsed data to prisma.credential.update. Writing the literal sentinel string 'refresh_token' into stored credentials would corrupt real OAuth tokens and break subsequent refreshes when the sync endpoint omits the field. This is a verifiable defect introduced by the diff.
